name: separator
useFor: Use between groups inside a Bone panel (rows of values, the parts of a card, toolbar groups with orientation="vertical"). Set strong for the rule under a table head or at the edge of a panel. It is decorative unless you set decorative={false}.
source: Figma UI · Agent chat (443:433): the Mist rules of Cited fields (443:470)
title: Separator
description: A 1px rule in Mist inside a panel, or Stone at a panel's edge (strong), across or down.
